title: Station state post with the node fields
description: Designed (docs/nodes.md 5 "Wire contract"), not implemented. Today's state post (station-state.schema.json) plus the optional keys a node adds: its capabilities and the two halves of the resync. Every new key is optional, so every post a station sends today is valid here, and a hub from before this ignores them. Resync is by content hash, never by a counter: a restart, a rollback or a restored replica can then never leave the two sides agreeing on a number and disagreeing on the content.

capabilities_rev.description: On every post: the content hash of the node's capabilities as it would send them now. The hub compares it with the version it holds.

roles_applied.description: On every post: the `roles_rev` of the roles this node has applied; "" when it has applied none. The hub sends the full roles only when this differs from its own `roles_rev`.

rev.title: Content hash
rev.description: A digest of the content it names, as 8 to 64 lower-case hex characters. Compared for equality only; nothing is read from it and it is never ordered.
